body.p: A fish and a raven. There lived a fish. There lived her children. Once their mother fell ill. The children felt very sorry for their mother. They were crying all the time. Their mother was lying in the corner of the tent for two months. One day, the eldest daughter of the fish went outside. On the street, on a tree, an old raven is sitting. The raven asked: "The eldest daughter of the fish, why are you sad?" The fish's daughter answered: "Our mother is ill." Then the raven said: "Fish, don't be sad, I will cure your mother. When I will treat her, if you hear your mother's scream, do not enter the tent.[ShA:] I replaced unclear malÊ¼gun to expected mabut, as well as nÉdutaraÊ and nÊ¼eraÊ. From screaming, her illness will go away on its own." The old raven entered the tent. The fish is lying there in the corner of the tent. The old raven came up there. He said: "Why are you lying here?" "I am ill. I have been lying in this corner of the tent already for two months." "I'm going to start treating you now." The raven suddenly pecked a sick fish with its beak. The fish cried, "My children, where are you? "The raven wants to kill me." The children of the fish heard their mother's scream outside. The fish's elder daughter said: "The old crow said not to enter the tent if we hear our mother's cry." After a while, the raven went outside again. He sat down on a tree again. Then the children of the fish went to the tent to see their mother. They looked, there were only bones left from their poor mother. The children of the fish became more sad than before. Outside, the old [ShA:] Using raven laughing says: "Didn't I deceive you?". Hearing such words, the children of the fish went outside.GEN form Å¡itaÊ instead of ACC Å¡izizaÊ is unexpected. They immediately jumped into the water. Since that they began to live in the water. The eldest daughter of a fish out of the water says: "Raven, you're not going anywhere from us now." After all, there is no hole in the earth. (?). You will not hide from us anywhere. They pushed the raven into the water. The eldest daughter of the fish said: "Why did you eat our mother?[ShA:] BudÊ¼i is 2du, nooba is 1pl, I switched everything to 2du. Now you will die yourself." The raven drowned in the water. From that time on, all the fish began to live in the water.
